description: This file contains a test script that verifies database connectivity using environment variables for configuration. It defines an asynchronous function to connect to a PostgreSQL database and performs a simple query to confirm the connection works, printing status messages accordingly.

methods.name: test_connection()
methods.description: Asynchronously tests the database connection using environment variables. Raises an error if required variables are missing, attempts to connect to the database, performs a simple query, and returns True if successful or False if not.
